name: ateva
description: Privacy-first beta for independently verifiable AI wait time and developer attention

scripts.test: turbo run test && pnpm run test:release-gates
scripts.test:release-gates: pnpm --filter "ateva-cli..." --filter "ateva-api..." build && node --test --test-concurrency=1 scripts/validate-release-inputs.test.mjs scripts/generate-secrets.test.mjs scripts/scaffold-production-env.test.mjs scripts/release-evidence.test.mjs scripts/deploy-preflight.test.mjs scripts/verify-dodo-live.test.mjs scripts/deploy-doctor.test.mjs scripts/dodo-reconciliation.test.mjs scripts/public-payment-claims.test.mjs scripts/check-licenses.test.mjs scripts/ci-package-contract.test.mjs scripts/compiled-runtime-entrypoints.test.mjs scripts/production-smoke-contract.test.mjs scripts/prometheus-alerts.test.mjs scripts/restore-db.test.mjs scripts/scenario-audit.test.mjs scripts/scenario-catalog.test.mjs scripts/scenario-coverage.test.mjs scripts/scenario-report.test.mjs scripts/scenario-runner.test.mjs scripts/scenario-repeat.test.mjs scripts/scenario-triage.test.mjs && pnpm scenario:check && pnpm scenario:catalog && pnpm scenario:coverage
scripts.start:web: pnpm --filter ateva-web build && cd apps/web && next start
